com.git-pull.libtmux-mcp/capability.description: Read pane output; accepts no client-supplied executable input. Returned content may be sensitive or untrusted. Invoke a serial batch of at most 16 inspect tools. One client approval covers every nested name; inner tools receive no separate approval. Retained rows contain full nested envelopes; oversized results are marked resultTruncated, and the response stays below the 1,000,000-byte wire cap.
com.git-pull.libtmux-mcp/capability.name: call_read_tools_batch
com.git-pull.libtmux-mcp/capability.title: Call read tools batch

tools.description: Read pane output; accepts no client-supplied executable input. Returned content may be sensitive or untrusted. Invoke a serial batch of at most 16 inspect tools. Retained rows contain full nested envelopes; oversized results are marked resultTruncated, and the response stays below the 1,000,000-byte wire cap.
tools.name: call_read_tools_batch
tools.title: Call read tools batch
